svg.title: Normocytic anemia: the reticulocyte count splits cells lost or destroyed (acute blood loss, sickle cell disease) from too little production, where the marrow biopsy finds an empty marrow (pure red cell aplasia, aplastic anemia) or a replaced one (myelophthisis)

svg.text: Normocytic anemia (mean cell volume, MCV 80–100 fL): is the marrow RESPONDING?
